longBusinessSummary: Almco Plumbing, Inc. provides plumbing services in the United States. The company offers plumbing repair, plumbing repair and installations, whole house repiping, water pipe leak detection, water leak repair, water line repair and installation, slab leak repair, water heater installation, gas line, pipe repairing and repiping, fixture installation and repair, water filtration system, and backflow prevention services. It also provides drain and sewer services, such as camera inspection, hydro getting, drain snaking and cleaning, carbide chain descaling, rooter, septic plumbing, sewer line repair and replacement, sewer system backups, flood restoration, sewer cleaning and maintenance, drain cleaning, sewer line inspection, storm drain, sewer line installation, and root intrusion removal services. In addition, the company offers trenchless pipe services, including epoxy lining, spray epoxy pipe lining, cured-in-place (CIPP) pipe inversion, CIPP pull-in-place, and pipe bursting services; water heater maintenance services; and boiler replacement services. It serves the single-family residential market comprising housing projects, small condominium projects, and town house development; the multifamily residential market consisting of apartment projects and condominiums; and the commercial market, such as retail establishments, office buildings, hotels, manufacturing plants, and other industrial complexes, as well as homeowners, businesses, and property managers. Almco Plumbing, Inc. was founded in 2001 and is based in San Diego, California.
